column6: F: How does this compare? | M: JasperReports builds nested grids with subreports. BIRT and SSRS do support nesting, with limits of their own. Excel template libraries expand rows and rewrite formulas. Here, the layout is the Excel sheet itself: rows push down, and the formulas follow.
